title: clean-route
description: Portable adaptive entry router for Clean Code workflow selection.

required: route decision with roles, evidence, reasons, and fallback

evidence_requirements: Deterministic route decision artifact; report unavailable host capabilities honestly.
stop_conditions: Stop when signals are invalid or a required capability would have to be invented.

tool_free_mode.behavior: Provide the decision template and exact unavailable capability; never claim a tool action occurred.
